# Employees First

Employees First is a voluntary-benefits transparency company for employers. Its financial model — built to support a documented, prudent fiduciary process — lies on top of fully-insured voluntary benefit programs — Accident, Hospital Indemnity, and Critical Illness — to make the invisible visible: exact claims paid, reserves and admin costs, all compensation, and carrier charges. Captured excess premium dollars flow back to the employer's benefits program, and the employer chooses how to reinvest them: lower employee costs, increased coverage, supplemental programs or perks, plan-expense funding, enrollment platform support, or recruitment, retention, and employee well-being.

- Founder: Amy Hollis, Founder & Chief Executive Officer — more than 20 years of benefits expertise; created and led national voluntary benefit practices at Willis Towers Watson, Buck (formerly Conduent/Xerox), and Marsh McLennan (Mercer).
- The company reports unlocking over $44,000,000 for employee benefit reinvestment since 2023, and that most employers see over 25% savings in the first year.
- Services: Plan Analytics (SHOp), Program Management, Compliance Oversight, and an Employer Dashboard with projections vs. actual plan performance.
- This site covers: How It Works, Program Services, Our Story, Our Team (leadership plus advisory board and consultants), a Frequently Asked Questions section, a savings estimator, a comparison page at /compare (traditional carrier vs voluntary benefits group captive vs Employees First — facts still being verified are clearly marked "Confirm" on the page), and a contact form. Client case studies publish here once approved.
- Key category terms: voluntary benefits captive, group captive, supplemental benefits, loss ratio.
- The company also publishes a blog and the Benefits Companion Podcast on its original site.

Contact: through the contact form at https://www.myemployeesfirst.com/
